status: exploratory high-temperature Ag liquid-like state observed
reason_onset_not_established: The 300 K starting geometry has only 7.7597% FCC/HCP atoms by PTM; it is not a mostly crystalline Ag reference.

simulation.method: LAMMPS direct uniform NVT heating of Ag; not TTM
simulation.Ag_Ag_potential: Ag_u3.eam (Foiles et al. file archived in repository)
simulation.skeleton: Ti/Si/C coordinates fixed; not integrated and not a heat sink

melting_indicators.Q6: LAMMPS compute orientorder/atom, l=6, explicit cutoff 3.8 Angstrom; mean and fraction above 0.30 are descriptive
melting_indicators.MSD: LAMMPS compute msd on Ag relative to the 300 K equilibrated starting coordinates

interpretation: Combined loss of PTM crystal classification, decreasing first-shell Q6, and increasing MSD supports a strongly disordered mobile liquid-like Ag state at high temperature. It does not establish an equilibrium melting point or an onset from crystalline Ag.
